chunks: We sent before you none (as apostles) but men, to whom We sent revelations. In case you are unaware, enquire of those who are keepers of the Oracles of God.

key_terms.رِجَالًا: men (human males, as opposed to angels)

ai.seo_question: Who are the Ahl al-Dhikr and what is their role in Islamic guidance?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the humanity of the prophets to distinguish them from divine beings, while 'Ahl al-Dhikr' is often interpreted as the Ahl al-Bayt or the Imams, serving as the living repository of revelation. It establishes a theological framework where divine guidance is accessible through authoritative human intermediaries, reinforcing the necessity of scholarly and Imamate-based interpretation (Tafsir) for the community.
